# Roku

> Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Today, our platform reaches nearly half of U.S. broadband households — powering how people discover, watch, and enjoy entertainment on the biggest screen in the home. This file exists to make Roku just as easy to navigate for AI as our products are for people: everything you need, clearly organized, no guesswork required.

Roku offers streaming players, smart TVs, The Roku Channel (a free ad-supported service with 500+ live TV channels), smart home products, and platforms for developers and advertisers. We're based in San Jose, California, and driven by one goal: better TV for everyone.

## Products

- [Streaming Players](https://www.roku.com/products/players): Roku streaming devices that connect to any TV via HDMI to deliver access to thousands of streaming channels
- [Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv): Smart televisions with Roku OS built in, offering a seamless streaming experience from a variety of TV brand partners
- [Smart Home](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home): Roku smart home products including cameras, video doorbells, smart lights, and smart plugs that integrate with the Roku ecosystem
- [Accessories](https://www.roku.com/products/accessories): Replacement Roku remotes, TV mounts, cables, and other accessories for Roku devices
- [Deals](https://www.roku.com/deals): Current deals and promotions on Roku products

## Streaming Devices

- [Compare Streaming Players](https://www.roku.com/products/players/compare): Side-by-side feature comparison of all Roku streaming devices including resolution support, HDR capabilities, Wi-Fi standards, remote features, and pricing to help users choose the best player for their setup
- [Roku Ultra](https://www.roku.com/products/players/roku-ultra): Roku's premium 4K streaming player with quad-core processor, Wi-Fi 6, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, and the Voice Remote Pro (2nd edition) with USB-C charging and lost remote finder
- [Roku Streaming Stick 4K](https://www.roku.com/products/players/roku-streaming-stick-4k): Compact HDMI streaming stick with 4K, HDR, and Dolby Vision support for a portable yet powerful streaming experience
- [Roku Streaming Stick 4K+](https://www.roku.com/products/players/roku-streaming-stick-4k-plus): 4K HDR streaming stick with a long-range Wi-Fi receiver built into the power cord for extended wireless reach
- [Roku Streaming Stick](https://www.roku.com/products/players/roku-streaming-stick): Entry-level HD streaming stick that can be powered by a TV's USB port, featuring a voice remote with TV controls
- [Roku Streambar SE](https://www.roku.com/products/players/roku-streambar-se): 2-in-1 4K streaming device and soundbar with enhanced speech clarity, automatic commercial volume leveling, and Bluetooth speaker functionality

## Roku TVs

- [Roku Pro Series TV](https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv/roku-made-tvs/pro-series): Premium 4K QLED smart TV with mini-LED backlighting, Dolby Vision IQ, Roku Smart Picture technology, 120Hz refresh rate for gaming, and the rechargeable Roku Voice Remote Pro with hands-free voice controls
- [Roku Plus Series TV](https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv/roku-made-tvs/plus-series): 4K QLED smart TV with mini-LED backlighting, Dolby Vision, and Dolby Atmos in 55" to 75" screen sizes with enhanced Roku voice remote
- [Roku Select Series 4K TV](https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv/roku-made-tvs/select-series-4k): Affordable smart TV available in 4K QLED resolutions from 43" to 85" with built-in Roku OS, Dolby Audio, and automatic brightness adjustment; larger 4K models feature QLED panels
- [Roku Select Series HD TV](https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv/roku-made-tvs/select-series-HD): Affordable smart TV available in HD and FHD resolutions from 24" to 40" with built-in Roku OS and Dolby Audio.
- [Roku TV Ease of Use](https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv/ease-of-use): Overview of Roku TV's intuitive interface, simple setup, and user-friendly navigation designed to make streaming accessible for everyone
- [Roku TV Features](https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv/features): Detailed breakdown of Roku TV capabilities including voice control, smart home integration, automatic software updates, and personalization options
- [Roku TV Picture Quality](https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv/picture-quality): Overview of Roku TV display technologies including 4K resolution, QLED, mini-LED backlighting, HDR support, Dolby Vision, and Roku Smart Picture settings
- [Roku TV Options for Every Room](https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv/options-for-every-room): Guide to choosing the right Roku TV based on room size, viewing distance, and use case — from compact bedroom models to large-screen living room displays

## Roku TV Finder

- [Roku TV Finder](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv): Browse and compare all Roku TV models across partner brands, with filtering by screen size, resolution, features, and price to find the right Roku TV
- [TCL Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv/tcl): Browse TCL-branded Roku TV models with built-in Roku OS, available in a range of screen sizes and resolutions
- [onn. Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv/onn): Browse onn.-branded Roku TV models with built-in Roku OS, available in a range of screen sizes and resolutions
- [Hisense Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv/hisense): Browse Hisense-branded Roku TV models with built-in Roku OS, available in a range of screen sizes and resolutions
- [Philips Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv/philips): Browse Philips-branded Roku TV models with built-in Roku OS, available in a range of screen sizes and resolutions
- [Sharp Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv/sharp): Browse Sharp-branded Roku TV models with built-in Roku OS, available in a range of screen sizes and resolutions
- [Westinghouse Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv/westinghouse): Browse Westinghouse-branded Roku TV models with built-in Roku OS, available in a range of screen sizes and resolutions
- [HIRO Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv/hiro): Browse HIRO-branded Roku TV models with built-in Roku OS, available in a range of screen sizes and resolutions
- [Pioneer Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv/pioneer): Browse Pioneer-branded Roku TV models with built-in Roku OS, available in a range of screen sizes and resolutions
- [ProScan Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv/proscan): Browse ProScan-branded Roku TV models with built-in Roku OS, available in a range of screen sizes and resolutions
- [JVC Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/finder/roku-tv/jvc): Browse JVC-branded Roku TV models with built-in Roku OS, available in a range of screen sizes and resolutions

## Smart Home

- [Roku Indoor Camera](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/cameras/roku-indoor-camera): 1080p HD indoor security camera with color night vision and two-way audio
- [Roku Indoor Camera 360](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/cameras/roku-indoor-camera-360): 1080p HD indoor security camera with 360° pan-and-tilt tracking, color night vision, and two-way audio
- [Roku Outdoor Camera](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/cameras/roku-outdoor-wired-camera): Weather-resistant wired outdoor security camera with 1080p HD video and color night vision
- [Roku Floodlight Camera](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/cameras/roku-floodlight-camera): Outdoor security camera with 1080p HD video, motion-activated dimmable floodlights, siren, color night vision, and two-way audio
- [Roku Video Doorbell Wired](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/doorbells/roku-video-doorbell-chime): Wired video doorbell with 1440p HD video, color night vision, and two-way audio using existing doorbell wiring
- [Roku Video Doorbell Wire-Free](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/doorbells/roku-wire-free-video-doorbell-chime): Wire-free battery-powered video doorbell with 1440p HD video, color night vision, two-way audio, and up to six months battery life
- [Roku Smart Bulb (White)](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/lights/roku-smart-bulb-se-white): Wi-Fi connected smart bulb with customizable brightness and color temperature, voice control, scheduling, and sunlight match
- [Roku Smart Bulb (Color)](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/lights/roku-smart-bulb-se-color): Wi-Fi connected smart bulb with 16 million color options, customizable brightness, voice control, and scheduling
- [Roku Smart Plug (Indoor)](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/plugs/roku-indoor-smart-plug-se): Indoor smart plug to control ordinary appliances remotely with scheduling, voice control, and automation
- [Roku Smart Plug (Outdoor)](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/plugs/roku-outdoor-smart-plug-se): Weather-resistant outdoor smart plug with long-range Wi-Fi connectivity, remote control, and custom scheduling

## Accessories

- [Roku Voice Remote Pro (2nd Edition)](https://www.roku.com/products/accessories/roku-voice-remote-pro-2nd-edition): Premium rechargeable remote with USB-C charging, hands-free voice controls ("Hey Roku"), touch-activated backlit buttons, lost remote finder, private listening headphone jack, and personalized Quick Launch shortcuts
- [Roku Voice Remote](https://www.roku.com/products/accessories/roku-voice-remote): Standard remote with one-touch voice search, TV power and volume buttons, preset app shortcut buttons, and a simple button layout for easy navigation
- [Roku TV Remote](https://www.roku.com/products/accessories/roku-tv-remote): Basic replacement remote for Roku TV models with standard IR navigation, TV power and volume controls, and preset app shortcut buttons
- [Roku Simple Remote](https://www.roku.com/products/accessories/roku-simple-remote): Basic replacement remote for Roku Player models with standard IR navigation, TV power and volume controls, and preset app shortcut buttons
- [Roku Wireless Speakers](https://www.roku.com/products/accessories/roku-wireless-speakers): Pair of wireless speakers designed for Roku TV models that deliver immersive room-filling stereo sound, with simple wireless pairing, dialogue boost, and automatic volume leveling
- [Roku Pro Series Wall Mount](https://www.roku.com/products/accessories/roku-pro-series-wall-mount): Slim-profile wall mount designed specifically for Roku Pro Series TVs with easy installation, low-profile flush mounting, and integrated cable management

## Content & Streaming

- [What's On](https://www.roku.com/whats-on): Central hub for discovering what to watch on Roku, including trending content, new releases, free movies and TV shows, live TV, and sports across streaming services
- [The Roku Channel](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/the-roku-channel): Free streaming service offering an ever-changing selection of movies, TV shows, Roku Originals, live news, and kids' programming, with the option to add premium subscriptions — available on Roku devices, Amazon Fire TV, Google TV, Samsung TVs, web browsers, and mobile apps
- [Live TV](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/live-tv): Over 500 free live TV channels on The Roku Channel accessible from the Roku home screen, with a Live TV guide for easy navigation, plus integration with paid services like Sling TV, Hulu + Live TV, Philo, and Fubo, and support for free local over-the-air channels via HDTV antenna on Roku TVs
- [Streaming Store](https://channelstore.roku.com/browse): Browse and add streaming channels and apps organized by category including entertainment, live TV, sports, kids, music & podcasts, news, comedy, and more — with premium subscriptions, free channels, and rent/buy options from services like Fandango at Home
- [Sports](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/stream-live-sports): Sports Zone hub for finding and tracking favorite sports, leagues, and teams across streaming services, with over 500 free live TV channels including dedicated sports channels (NBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, NASCAR, PGA TOUR, UFC, FIFA+), plus integration with ESPN, Peacock, Paramount+, and other premium sports apps
- [Roku Originals](https://therokuchannel.roku.com/browse/roku-originals): Original programming produced exclusively for The Roku Channel

## Subscriptions & Premium Subscriptions

- [Subscriptions through Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/subscriptions): Subscribe to and manage premium streaming services such as Netflix, HBO Max, Disney+, and more through Roku
- [Howdy on Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/the-roku-channel/premium-subscriptions/howdy): Subscribe to Howdy through The Roku Channel for access to its content library directly on Roku devices
- [STARZ on Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/the-roku-channel/premium-subscriptions/starz): Subscribe to STARZ through The Roku Channel for access to original series, movies, and exclusive content directly on Roku devices
- [Max on Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/the-roku-channel/premium-subscriptions/max): Subscribe to Max through The Roku Channel for access to HBO originals, Warner Bros. films, and exclusive content directly on Roku devices
- [Paramount+ on Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/the-roku-channel/premium-subscriptions/paramount-plus): Subscribe to Paramount+ through The Roku Channel for access to original series, live sports, and movies directly on Roku devices
- [Peacock on Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/the-roku-channel/premium-subscriptions/peacock): Subscribe to Peacock through The Roku Channel for access to NBCUniversal content, live sports, and original series directly on Roku devices
- [MGM+ on Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/the-roku-channel/premium-subscriptions/mgm-plus): Subscribe to MGM+ through The Roku Channel for access to MGM's library of films and original series directly on Roku devices
- [Apple TV+ on Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/the-roku-channel/premium-subscriptions/apple-tv): Subscribe to Apple TV+ through The Roku Channel for access to Apple original series and films directly on Roku devices
- [Disney+ on Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/subscriptions/disney-plus): Subscribe to Disney+ through Roku for access to Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, and National Geographic content directly on Roku devices
- [AMC+ on Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/the-roku-channel/premium-subscriptions/amc-plus): Subscribe to AMC+ through The Roku Channel for access to AMC originals, exclusive series, and classic films directly on Roku devices
- [Hulu on Roku](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/subscriptions/hulu): Subscribe to Hulu through Roku for access to current-season TV, original series, movies, and live TV options directly on Roku devices

## Company

- [What is Roku](https://www.roku.com/what-is-roku): Overview of the Roku platform, its value proposition, and how streaming works on Roku devices
- [Support Home](https://support.roku.com/): Customer support hub with FAQs, troubleshooting guides, setup instructions, and contact options
- [Blog](https://www.roku.com/blog): Official Roku blog with product news, feature announcements, and streaming content updates
- [About Roku](https://www.roku.com/about/company): Company information, mission, leadership, and corporate overview
- [Roku Advertising](https://advertising.roku.com/): Roku's advertising platform for brands and agencies to reach streaming audiences with data-driven solutions
- [Investor Relations](https://www.roku.com/investor): Financial reports, SEC filings, earnings calls, and shareholder information
- [Careers](https://www.weareroku.com/): Job openings, culture, and benefits at Roku

The delightfully simple way to TV

TV that's built around you

With setup that only takes minutes, a simple-to-navigate Home Screen, and an uncluttered remote control that does all you need, Roku makes it easier to watch the TV you love.

A world of free entertainment

Enjoy great free TV anytime you want it, from a huge selection of movies, shows, and a Live TV Guide with 500+ free TV channels. Explore news, sports, Roku Originals, and much more in one click.

Check it out

FAQs

Roku is a streaming platform that connects your TV to the apps and channels you want to watch.

Here's how Roku works:

  • Hardware options: Roku streaming players plug into any TV with an HDMI port; Roku TV comes in two forms: TVs made by Roku, and smart TVs from partner brands like TCL, Hisense, and Philips with Roku's OS.
  • All your apps in one place: Both give you access to Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, The Roku Channel, and thousands of other apps from a single home screen. Subscriptions may be required for some apps.
  • Simple by design: All Roku devices come with voice search, a single home screen, and automatic software updates.

Once you own a device, the Roku platform itself is free to use; there's no subscription fee. Streaming players and Roku TV models are available at a range of price points to fit your budget.

Once you're set up, here's what you get:

  • Free content included: The Roku Channel comes free with your device, with live TV, movies, and on-demand content. No subscription needed.
  • Third-party services, your choice: Add paid streaming services like Netflix, Hulu, or Prime Video if you want them. Roku doesn't add any fees on top of what those services charge.
  • No lock-in: No contracts or cancellation fees from Roku. Add or remove any streaming service whenever you like.

Roku gives you access to thousands of streaming apps and 500+ free TV channels with live TV.

Here's what's available:

  • Free content: The Roku Channel gives you live news, movies, shows, sports, kids' TV, and Roku Originals at no charge. No subscription required.
  • Top paid services: Netflix, Hulu, HBO Max, Prime Video, Disney+, and Apple TV+ are all available in the Roku Channel Store.
  • Free live TV: Live TV is also free, including local news, weather, and live sports.
  • Cable TV: Cable subscribers can download their provider's app and watch cable channels on Roku at no extra cost.

Most setups take under five minutes. No cable subscription required, no contracts.

Here's what you need and how to get started:

  • What you'll need: A TV with an HDMI port, a Wi-Fi connection, and a Roku streaming player.
  • Connect and power on: Plug the player into your TV's HDMI port and power it on.
  • Complete setup: Follow the on-screen steps to connect to Wi-Fi and create a free Roku account.
  • Have a Roku TV?: Skip the HDMI step. Power on the TV, connect to Wi-Fi, and sign in to your Roku account.
See you in Roku.
